pages.text: $(bold)Upgrade-slot modifier - Cursed Tempo$(): the words leave your tongue at once, no long recital needed.(br2)Effect: cursed speech chant time x max(0.1, 1/(level+1)) - L1 0.50x, L2 0.33x, L3 0.25x, L4 0.20x, L5 0.17x (up to 10x speed).(br2)Restriction: $(l)curse cores only$(); $(l)level 1 costs 1 upgrade slot$(), levels 2-5 are free, max level 5.
$(bold)Recipes$():(br)Level 1: Sugar x2 + Lapis Lazuli(br)Levels 2-3: Clock + Amethyst Shard x2(br)Levels 4-5: Echo Shard x2 + Clock
